title: tehas question --json, with no issue
description: What tehas question --json prints with no issue, version 1: the question each issue waits on, or with --after <id> every question whose number is greater than <id>, the answered and the withdrawn among them, in number order. host/docs/api.md says what each field means. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. console/tests/answer.rs checks that the command prints the samples beside this file, and test/json_contract_test.sh that they fit it.

id.description: The state store's own number of the question, given in order and never reused.

comment.description: The id of the comment on the issue that asked the question. Left out when the store has no comment for it; never null.

cycle.description: The id of the cycle that stopped, <issue>-<attempt>: a park's question alone.

answeredAt.description: When it was answered: an answered question alone.

withdrawnAt.description: When the host withdrew it: a withdrawn question alone.

choices.description: Exactly the choices the question offers, in the order it lists them. Left out for a planning question the issue no longer waits on: its options are kept only while it waits.
